evals.expected_output: Skill auto-detects legacy mode (no status fields), reads agent-tasks.yml and the sibling agent-tasks-state.yml, picks the first task whose (repo, text) is not in state.completed, completes it, removes it from agent-tasks.yml, appends a completed entry to agent-tasks-state.yml, and prints a summary with progress and next-up.

evals.prompt: Run agent-tasks — no state file yet, this is the first day.
evals.expected_output: Skill detects legacy mode, treats missing agent-tasks-state.yml as empty, picks the very first task in the config, completes it, creates agent-tasks-state.yml with that entry.

evals.prompt: Run task-agent tasks=tasks.yml — this file uses the unified format.
evals.description: Unified mode with explicit tasks= argument and no state file. Validates id-based picking, in-place status rewrite, and unknown-key preservation.
evals.expected_output: Skill reads tasks.yml, auto-detects unified mode (status fields present), picks the first task whose status is pending, executes it, then rewrites tasks.yml flipping that one task's status to done and appending branch/pr_url/date - without dropping any other tasks' unknown keys (e.g. external_ref, labels). No state file is created.

evals.prompt: Run task-agent tasks=board.yml. The file has tasks with external_ref keys.
evals.description: Passthrough metadata preservation - the contract the gh-project-sync skill depends on.
evals.expected_output: After completion, the rewritten board.yml retains every task's external_ref (and any other unknown keys) exactly as they were. Only the completed task's status flips and completion metadata is added to that same entry.

evals.prompt: Run agent-tasks.yml. All tasks are already done.
evals.expected_output: Skill detects no pending tasks (no entry with status=pending in unified mode; everything matches state.completed in legacy mode) and tells the user - nothing left to do. No files modified.

evals.prompt: Process the next item in my task queue. Show me what's left after.
evals.expected_output: Skill completes one task and prints a progress line (e.g. '3 of 7 tasks completed') plus a 'Next up' line showing the following pending task. Counts include done/failed/skipped against total.

evals.prompt: Run task-agent on tasks.yml. The first pending task targets a repo that no longer exists.
evals.description: Failure / skip handling - verifies status=failed or status=skipped is used instead of leaving the task pending or pretending it's done.
evals.expected_output: Skill detects the repo is gone, records the task with status=failed (and an error field) or status=skipped (and a reason field), then moves on. The task does NOT remain pending and is not retried on the next run.
